criterion_text: When a writable RootFS is explicitly selected, writes remain confined to its transient Upper and are removed only after verified execution cleanup; immutable backing Image bytes and other Sessions remain unchanged.

verifiers.summary: Writable RootFS writes stay in a disposable execution-owned upper, never mutate the immutable image, disappear after verified cleanup, and a failed preparation stays retryable through its durable record

evidence.value: exact SHA ab4120cd1485bdbc5e3721f454a2a910f2366a84 on Linux kernel 7.0.0-1014-aws: a writable RootFS wrote through an execution-owned transient upper, the write was recorded and visible only in that execution; cleanup strictly unmounted and removed the transient upper/work, the Base image bytes stayed identical, and a later execution was isolated. A preparation that failed after mounting kept its durable recovery record; the failed strict unmount retained the view and lower consumer, and a restart released the lower only after the verified unmount
